items.question: In what auspicious support must the mantra-holder perform the ritual invocation?
premises: The mantra-holder is the prescribed ritual agent.
Invocation is the action to be performed.
An auspicious image or similar support serves as the locus.
items.inference: Therefore, the mantra-holder should perform the invocation in an auspicious image or similar support.
uncertainties: The specific range of supports included by 'ādi' in pratimādau is not specified.
items.plain_english: The mantra-holder should likewise perform the invocation in an auspicious image or similar support.
